title: Highrise headline account today

change.control: Headline “Start a Highrise Account”; subhead emphasizes a 30-day free trial, pay-as-you-go service and no hidden fees.
change.variant: Headline adds Today to “Start a Highrise Account”; subhead emphasizes pay as you go, no long-term contracts, no hidden fees and no surprises.

result.metric: clicks on a paid-plan Sign Up button

sample_size.unit: page views across five headline/subhead combinations

quote: Third place: 15% better conversion than the original
notes: One variant-versus-original comparison from a five-arm test, not an independent study. Clicks are not completed paid subscriptions. Publisher stopped at 4,000 page views after observing stable results; achieved significance not reported.

verification_details.reason: company, lift and supporting quote confirmed; not a statistical replication
